idea: Factor the quadratic equations satisfied by x² and y² to show that each is either 2 or 3. Their strict ordering forces x² = 2 and y² = 3.
proof:
have hx : (x ^ 2 - 2) * (x ^ 2 - 3) = 0 := by
  rw [h₀, h₁] at h₂
  nlinarith [h₂]
have hy : (y ^ 2 - 2) * (y ^ 2 - 3) = 0 := by
  rw [h₀, h₁] at h₃
  nlinarith [h₃]
rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with hx | hx <;>
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hy with hy | hy <;>
  nlinarith [h₄]
